entities.summary: Yankuba Sima Fatty, is a Gambian-Spanish professional basketball player for Valencia of the Spanish Liga ACB and EuroLeague. He has also represented the Spanish national team internationally. Standing at 6 ft 11 in, Sima plays in the center position.
